headline: EcoCard is the unique answer, but ruling out the Crypto-Cash Back card depends on a minimum credit score that the KB writes as a dollar amount ("$660").

issues.summary: The minimum credit score that decides between the two cards meeting the hard requirements is written as a currency value. It is still readable as 660, so the correct answer does not change.
evidence: doc_credit_cards_crypto-cash_back_009: "What is the minimum credit score to apply for the card to earn crypto rewards? $660."
doc_credit_cards_ecocard_001: "Minimum credit score required to apply: 0 (0 indicates no credit score requirement)."
task_006 user_scenario: "You have a credit score of 540."
issues.why_it_matters: Crypto-Cash Back (0% FTF, 1.5% minimum payment, virtual cards Yes) passes every hard requirement and only the 660 minimum excludes it. An agent that skips the corrupted FAQ-2 line, or doubts it, has two qualifying cards and no tie-breaker from the customer.
issues.suggested_fix: Write the score as "660" (and fix the other "$NNN" credit-score fields across card docs).

solution_check: Hard filters: FTF <= 1.5%, minimum payment <= 1.5%, virtual cards, credit score 540, no Rho-Bank+. Bronze and Silver fail on FTF (2.75%) and Silver also lacks virtual cards; Gold needs Rho-Bank+ (and 2.0% minimum); Platinum 2.5% and Diamond 3.0% minimum payment fail. Crypto-Cash Back passes on terms (crypto_008: FTF 0%, minimum 1.5%, virtual Yes) but needs a 660 score. EcoCard (ecocard_008: minimum 1.0%, FTF 1.0%, virtual Yes; ecocard_001: score 0) is the only card left. Replaying EcoCard/Bob Nakamoto/95000/false matches the gold.
prior_note: Prior marked this clean; the dollar-formatted credit score is load-bearing here, so it is reported as a Minor issue.
notes: Grading-model check (snapshot v1.0.1): confirmed _derive_read_log_allowlist, parse_int=float in call_discoverable_agent_tool/call_discoverable_user_tool, apply_for_credit_card casts annual_income to float, Action.compare_with_tool_call ignores requestor, fixed clock get_now()=2025-11-14 03:40:00. Verified scorer (_verified_db_match in working repo) read: only agent_discoverable_tools is relaxed (gold tool-name subset) and closure_reason is stripped; every other table exact. Crypto-Cash Back's credit-score requirement appears only in its FAQ-2 doc (crypto-cash_back_009), which is not in required_documents, so an agent must retrieve it to rule the card out. For tasks where the credit score is not load-bearing I logged this corruption as a note, not an issue.
